question: What categories are included among the varieties of the source?
premises: Division by thirty yields the lunar day.
House, day, lunar day, and conjunctions are listed.
These constitute varieties of the source.
inference: The lunar day and related categories such as house, day, and conjunctions are varieties of the source.
plain_english: Divided by thirty it becomes the lunar day; house, day, lunar day, conjunctions, and so on are varieties of the source.
